gloss: in the near future; within the next few days; shortly

definitions.gloss: in the near future; within the next few days; shortly
definitions.explanation: Refers to a period in the very near future, typically within the next several days. Used when the exact date is not specified but the action or event is expected soon.

examples.japanese: {近日中|きんじつちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We will notify you in the near future.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦ウェブサイト→ウェブサイト：05152_webusaito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{近日中|きんじつちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: The new website is scheduled to be launched shortly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完了|かんりょう}しました→完了する：20676_kanryousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{近日中|きんじつちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{届|とど}け→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: The repair is complete, so we will deliver it to you within the next few days.

notes:
A formal time expression used in business correspondence, announcements, and official communications. Implies a period of roughly a few days to a week, though the exact timeframe is intentionally vague.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近日中|きんじつちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to announce shortly
- {近日中|きんじつちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to release shortly
- {近日中|きんじつちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to contact shortly
- {近日中|きんじつちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: to arrive within a few days

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{近々|ちかぢか}→近々：00029_chikajika⟧: soon; before long — slightly more conversational and can cover a longer timeframe
- ⟦{間|ま}もなく→間もなく：02491_mamonaku⟧: shortly; any moment now — implies something more imminent, often minutes to hours
- ⟦そのうち→そのうち：00380_sonouchi⟧: eventually; before long — casual and vague about timing

REGISTER:
Primarily used in formal and written contexts. In casual speech, ⟦{近々|ちかぢか}→近々：00029_chikajika⟧ or ⟦もうすぐ→もうすぐ：01218_mousugu⟧ are more natural.
